title: Terrace-slab crack — measured vs guessed
sub: Terrace slab · Nov 2026 · Ref SC-25D35C5E · 2 INR coin (25 mm) for scale

photos.alt: Vertical crack in a terrace slab with a taped coin beside it and a yellow measuring tape held along the crack
photos.caption: Figure 1 — photo with tape: the measuring tape held along the crack is the ground truth (227 mm).

photos.alt: The same terrace-slab crack with the taped coin, photographed for the app measurement
photos.caption: Figure 2 — photo used for the guess: the same crack as the app measured it, photo + coin.

photos.alt: Bar chart: tape 227 mm, measured 218.5 mm inside ±10%, guess 315 mm outside
photos.caption: Figure 3 — the gap at a glance: the photo measurement lands inside the tape's ±10% band; the photo-alone guess does not.

method: Outlines measured from photo pixels, scaled by the coin diameter (tilt-corrected from its ellipse). Ground truth is the builder's physical tape, 22.5–23 cm along the crack (midpoint 227 mm). Every number cites its evidence receipt.
verification: Evidence gate: passed · Independent skeptic: not run · Mask cross-check: not run
